remarks: Brand new by Raj Built Homes, this exceptional corner-lot home in Rosenthal offers over 2,300 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space with a layout that truly stands out. Featuring 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and premium craftsmanship throughout, this home blends luxury with functionality. The main floor showcases a bright open-concept design with a dramatic open-to-above great room, a private office/bedroom, full bathroom, chef-inspired kitchen with a separate spice kitchen, spacious dining area, and convenient rear entry. Upstairs you'll find 3 generous bedrooms, including a stunning primary retreat with a spa-inspired ensuite and walk-in closet, a spacious bonus room with sitting area, upper-floor laundry, and additional full bathrooms. Situated on a desirable corner lot in the sought-after community of Rosenthal, this home offers modern design, quality finishes, and the exceptional craftsmanship Raj Built Homes is known for.
